mapper.select: SELECT ns.notification_setting_id, ns.user_id, ns.finance_notification_yn, ns.friend_notification_yn, ns.reward_notification_yn, ns.event_notification_yn, ns.updated_at FROM notification_setting_tbl ns INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON ns.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ns.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_setting_tbl ns INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON ns.user_id = u.user_id SET ns.finance_notification_yn = #{financeNotificationYn}, ns.friend_notification_yn = #{friendNotificationYn}, ns.reward_notification_yn = #{rewardNotificationYn}, ns.event_notification_yn = #{eventNotificationYn}, ns.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ns.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_setting_tbl ( user_id, finance_notification_yn, friend_notification_yn, reward_notification_yn, event_notification_yn, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{financeNotificationYn}, #{friendNotificationYn}, #{rewardNotificationYn}, #{eventNotificationYn}, NOW() )
